state: Inspect only visible freight container markings. Presence and geometry are separate.

id_present.instructions: Is the complete printed container identification: all four owner letters, six serial digits and the boxed check digit visible?

id_box.instructions: Locate the complete printed container identification: all four owner letters, six serial digits and the boxed check digit. Include its entire extent.

iso_present.instructions: Is the complete four-character printed ISO size/type code visible?

iso_box.instructions: Locate the complete four-character printed ISO size/type code. Include its entire extent.

weights_present.instructions: Is the complete printed weights panel including maximum gross, tare and payload figures and units visible?

weights_box.instructions: Locate the complete printed weights panel including maximum gross, tare and payload figures and units. Include its entire extent.

seal_present.instructions: Is the complete tamper-evident seal device and its printed number visible?

seal_box.instructions: Locate the complete tamper-evident seal device and its printed number. Include its entire extent.

hazard_present.instructions: Is the first actual diamond-shaped dangerous-goods placard, counting from top left; exclude residue or removed labels visible?

hazard_box.instructions: Locate the first actual diamond-shaped dangerous-goods placard, counting from top left; exclude residue or removed labels. Include its entire extent.

doorEnd_present.instructions: Is the complete container door end from corner post to corner post, including both door leaves visible?

doorEnd_box.instructions: Locate the complete container door end from corner post to corner post, including both door leaves. Include its entire extent.
